visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A tan and white Shiba Inu sits upright on a brown leather chair next to a wooden window frame in a sunlit cafe. The dog has a stoic, unmoving expression with its mouth firmly closed and its ears perked up. Sunlight enters through the large glass panes in the background, illuminating the scene. (2) A blue speech bubble containing Chinese text appears above the dog's head. Shortly after, a pink speech bubble with more text is overlaid. The dog remains in the same position, looking directly at the camera while the lens remains static on a medium shot. (3) The dog opens its mouth wide in a panting smile expression. A smartphone camera interface overlay appears, including a white shutter button and technical icons. Pink bokeh sparkles and purple lighting effects frame the dog's face as a new pink text bubble appears. (4) The visual effects and camera interface vanish, returning the frame to its original natural indoor lighting. The Shiba Inu continues to sit on the chair with its mouth open and tongue visible, maintaining a happy and relaxed posture as the video concludes.
